name: Run Python
summary: Runs Python from chat on this Mac, and shows the pictures and pages it makes.
author: Lasso

commands.title: Run Python
commands.howTo: Type **/run** to run the Python in the last reply, or **/run** and your code. It answers with what the code printed.

tool.name: run_python
tool.description: Run Python 3 code on this Mac in a sandbox (no internet, 20 s limit). Returns what it printed and any error.

patches.add: Each python code block in your reply has a Run button that runs it on the user's Mac and shows the output in the block; /run runs your last reply's code. When asked to run code, say so instead of saying you can't, and put runnable code in one python block. No windows open (no plt.show(), tkinter or turtle): to show a chart, save it to a file, like plt.savefig("chart.png") or an .html page, and Run shows it.
